title: JWST Mid-Infrared Spectra: The Hidden Chemical Fingerprint (2026)
description:
Most people look at JWST images and see pretty colors. They miss the data. This short breaks down how the MIRI instrument uses mid-infrared light to fingerprint specific molecules like CO2 and water in exoplanet atmospheres. 

We trace the exact spectral peaks that reveal a planet's composition, moving from raw light to chemical proof. It’s not just a picture; it’s a lab report from a world light-years away. 

#JWST #Exoplanet #SpaceScience #MIRI #Astronomy #MidInfrared #Spectroscopy #2026
